name: Quinton Hoover
description: Quinton Hoover (1964–2013) was an American illustrator renowned for his work in fantasy art and collectible card games. He contributed over 70 illustrations to Magic: The Gathering , including the iconic "Proposal" card used by game creator Richard Garfield to propose to his wife. Hoover also illustrated for other games like the Middle-earth Collectible Card Game and Dungeons & Dragons titles such as Monster Manual II and Book of Vile Darkness . He co-created the comic Morgana X and was known for his distinctive, elegant linework and storytelling flair.
